decision: Preserve each complete registered foreign generated-short-reference call until its generated name, group and bibliography dependencies have an independently approved source-bound migration. Positional resemblance alone is insufficient.

facts: The wrapper builds a #tag:ref name from trimmed numeric1..5 plus id, texte, p, pp, loc and ps without a FOOTNOTE prefix.
